caption: A strip of peel is torn off an orange starting from a slit in the top, exposing the segments underneath.

sa.check: An orange has a slit in its top.
A strip of peel is torn off from the slit.
The peel comes away as a strip.
The tear comes first and the bare patch follows.

pc.expect: The peel lifts only where it is worked loose and comes away as one piece, with pith fibres.
pc.fail: The peel shatters; or it flows; or it comes off all around in an instant.

pc.expect: The bare patch stays bare and the skin does not regrow.
pc.fail: The skin regrows; or the strip rejoins; or a second orange appears.

pc.expect: The bare patch is where the strip came off.
pc.fail: It is elsewhere; or the strip comes off and the orange is unchanged; or the patch is there before the peel comes off.

pc.expect: The torn peel hangs or drops.
pc.fail: It floats; or rises; or hangs unsupported.

pc.expect: One orange keeps its number, and the fingers do not pass through it.
pc.fail: The fingers pass through the orange; or the orange splits; or it turns into another fruit.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The orange's colour and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The orange changes colour; or the hands change; or the background rearranges.
